title: Frontend records scope visual-lab to profiles with a Figma section
body:
Outcome: a defect report for the host visual-lab skill states that `visual-lab.mjs` crashes with "BLOCKED: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'cache')" (exit 2) on a profile without a `figma` section, and that boilerplate-2026's mise task `vlab` calls absent scripts/vlab.mjs (exit 2); KRN's frontend records do not recommend visual-lab for projects without a Figma export until fixed.
Proof: a records test or standards text shows visual-lab is conditional on a profile with `figma.cache`; the report path .krn/runs/research/frontend-stack/report.md section "boilerplate-2026" holds the commands and exit codes.
